{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
patient_id_counts = data['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]

# Check how many rows have biomarker_baseline == -999
count_neg999 = (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()

# Print findings
print(f"Number of rows with biomarker_baseline == -999: {count_neg999}")
print(f"Number of patients with duplicate IDs: {len(duplicate_patients)}")
print(f"Duplicate patient IDs: {list(duplicate_patients.index)}")"}
